# Canonical Lean infrastructure

Only infrastructure imported by `HodgeReduction.lean` or the canonical modules is active. Historical infrastructure files are kept in pinned Git history and the generated legacy Lean artifact index.

Current foundational interfaces:

- `HodgeReduction/Infrastructure/HodgeStructure/Basic.lean`
- `HodgeReduction/Infrastructure/HodgeStructure/VarietyCohomology.lean`

New infrastructure becomes active only through an explicit canonical import and the normal Lean build.
